name: htmldrop-mcp
description: Publish HTML or Markdown to a real hosted URL from Claude. Turns anything Claude generates into a shareable page on htmldrop.app — CVs, portfolios, landing pages, dashboards, internal docs. Includes password protection, version history, and custom domains on paid plans.
long_description:
htmldrop is a SaaS HTML/Markdown hosting product. This MCP server gives Claude (and any other MCP-aware client) three tools:

• htmldrop_publish — take HTML or Markdown, return a public share URL
• htmldrop_list    — list every site under your account
• htmldrop_delete  — remove a site by id

Authentication uses an API token from your htmldrop dashboard. Create one at https://htmldrop.app/dashboard/settings → API tokens. The token is stored encrypted in your OS keychain by Claude Desktop and passed to the server at launch.

Free tier: 3 active drops, 30-day TTL. Starter/Pro/Business plans unlock more drops, custom domains, password protection, branding removal, and longer version history.

tools.name: htmldrop_publish
tools.description: Publish an HTML or Markdown document as a hosted page on htmldrop. Returns the public share URL.

tools.name: htmldrop_list
tools.description: List every site the authenticated tenant has published.

api_token.title: htmldrop API token
api_token.description: Create one in your dashboard at htmldrop.app/dashboard/settings → API tokens. Looks like hsk_live_… and starts with `hsk_`.

api_url.title: API base URL (advanced)
api_url.description: Override the API endpoint. Leave at the default unless you're running a self-hosted htmldrop.
